name: After § 12
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 12b. Calls on the Commission to ensure specific regulatory flexibility and allocated funds for outermost regions, including proportionate construction standards adapted to local climatic and geographical conditions, support for local building science and technical certification centres in cooperation with national and regional bodies, to evaluate materials suited to tropical and insular climates, ensure construction safety and resilience, and reduce excessive dependence on imported materials; encourages Member States, in outermost regions facing severe housing shortages, to introduce proportionate and temporary flexibility in the implementation timetable of EU energy-efficiency and housing-decency requirements, where these create excessive costs or risk removing large numbers of dwellings from the rental market;
